body:
Part of #114; split out under the reopening comment's instruction to ship all requirements or create linked follow-ups. PR #116 handles Safari cookie import; the original six data classes remain the migration API.

Add the remaining data classes consistently to JS, Rust, Python, CLI and command-stream:

- localStorage, IndexedDB and sessionStorage (source extraction, cross-engine translation and same-engine clone).
- autofill addresses; payment cards only behind an explicit opt-in flag.
- searchEngines, siteSettings/permissions, openTabs/sessions, downloads history, readingList and client certificates where OS facilities allow extraction.
- passkeys: report skipped with the explicit non-exportability reason for iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager and Windows Hello. Document signing in once with the platform passkey and retaining the session in a persistent controlled profile.
- Apply domains filtering to every per-site class: cookies, storage, passwords, history and permissions. Fix the existing Chromium history/password filtering gap as part of this scope.
- Every selected class must produce a migrated count or a skipped reason, with warnings for lossy translations; never report unsupported classes as successfully migrated.

Acceptance: source-family fixtures and target-engine round trips, domain-isolation tests, explicit-card consent tests, immutable sources, skipped/unsupported-class reporting and cross-language option/report parity. Update the generated source × target × data-class matrix as each capability lands.
title: Import remaining storage, autofill, settings, session and certificate data classes (#114)
